title: Does Your Voice Assistant Remember? Analyzing Conversational Context Recall and Utilization in Voice Interaction Models

layout.note: Three blue-framed rounded panels of different widths in one row, each with a title tab at the top; a curly brace at the right edge of the first panel points to the second; the stage panels hold two stacked boxes each with an icon at left; two output bubbles hang below and outside the third panel.

lesson: Draw a data-construction pipeline as titled stage panels with one icon and one model logo per step, and end with the finished sample as speech bubbles outside the frame, so the reader sees both the process and what one entry of the benchmark looks like.
